sermon.title: His Generation 9/17/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer reviews what God said to Jesus, then teaches Isaiah 53:7–8: the Lamb silent before Herod and Pilate, and the question “who shall declare his generation?” The answer is a people yet to be created—the church, a chosen generation that proclaims his praises, passes the faith on, and comes together for Jesus and one another.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: nations discovered till 1778; Tommy Hicks/Perón healing and stadium sizes (37,000 and 70,000); Indonesia water to grape juice in the 70s; “seventy five percent of American believers do not attend church”; Herod and Pilate’s regions. Sensitive content kept as spoken: seven-year tribulation teaching “totally bogus”; the Bible “not a book of faith”; ministers running off with church money or secretaries; Corinthian believers “having sex with their mother”; psychology and 12-step programs vs. Jesus; Facebook advice as “dummies trying to counsel dummies”; Carmen and the Newsboys drawing crowds.
